headline: Bahrain Leads GCC Joint Effort to Revive Tourism Following Regional Conflicts
summary: Bahrain is leading a joint initiative with Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Oman, and Kuwait to restore travel confidence. Tourism visitor counts fell sharply across the Gulf region after months of regional tension.
why: GCC economies rely heavily on tourism expansion to diversify economic revenue away from hydrocarbon extraction.

impacts.name: Bahrain
impacts.why: Coordinated Gulf tourism marketing attempts to recover lost international visitor volumes.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
